title: Kestrel and the Protocol
author: Noor Winterbourne
blurb: Mirabel Vasquez, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
